findings.title: Def hot-reload re-runs SetImmutability and reloads StatDef parts without re-running InjectStatParts
findings.detail: PlayDataLoader's hot-reload path calls ResetStaticDataPost (and so StatDef.SetImmutability) again, but the [StaticConstructorOnStartup] injector does not run again. If hot-reload rebuilds stat.parts from XML, StatPart_Entad is gone and a stat with no other parts can be marked immutable again. This only happens with the dev-mode def hot-reload, so players never hit it. Mentioned only because the build 11 comment assumes SetImmutability runs exactly once.

findings.title: gearFlags is a one-time snapshot of which ThingDefs carry CompProperties_Entad
findings.detail: IsEntadGearDef fills gearFlags on its first call and never rebuilds it, but CompProperties_Entad is added at runtime by EntadCompInjector, a separate [StaticConstructorOnStartup] class. Nothing in vanilla reaches the StatOffsetFromGear/GearAffectsStat postfixes during the static-constructor phase, so this is safe today. If another mod's static constructor evaluated pawn gear stats between the two injectors, every entad item would be treated as non-entad for the session. Building gearFlags at the end of EntadCompInjector's constructor (or resetting it to null there) closes that. This is my opinion of the risk; the ordering itself is cited.

findings.title: StatPart_GearStatOffset explanations call StatOffsetFromGear outside the InfoTextLineFromGear hiding window
findings.detail: Vanilla StatPart_GearStatOffset.GetStatValueForGear and InfoTextLineFrom build their own gear lines, so displayExcludesHidden is false there and Patch_StatOffsetFromGear returns the total including unrevealed traits. That matters only if a trait offsets one of its EquippedStatOffsets-category apparelStats (PsychicSensitivityOffset, PsychicEntropyMaxOffset, PsychicEntropyRecoveryRateOffset). No current Defs/EntadTraits_Stats.xml entry does, so nothing leaks today.
